notes.title: 7 Mages has been released!
notes.content:
Yesterday we left Early Access. The game is as finished as possible, however, we may still make changes if you request them. We will also fix all bugs.

The list of main changes in version 1.1.31110043 can be found at our official forum:
[url=store.steampowered.com] http://www.7mages.net/forum/viewtopic.php?f=7&t=1611[/url]

notes.title: Update 1.1.31079502
notes.content: Lots of things changed! We have add keybindings (combats can be fully controlled by keyboard, repeat last command and much more), PC graphics, some gameplay twists, hud adjustments. For (almost) complete list of changes see [url=http://www.7mages.net/forum/viewtopic.php?f=7&t=1175]topic at our official forum[/url].

notes.title: PC vs. Mobile Comparison
notes.content:
Today we would like to show you some progress of porting Mobile graphics to PC. Below you can find a video that demonstrates current state of our work - the job is almost done and we need just finish some details. Please note we have also made more space on HUD by moving minimap to the upper right corner and what is more important we add keyboard shortcuts! For example you can control all combat solely by keyboard.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=25piNZjU5dY

notes.title: Community Translations
notes.content:
Hi there,

while we are working hard on our first update, we have also opened all game texts to community translations. Find more at our official forums:

[url=store.steampowered.comhttp://www.7mages.net/forum/viewtopic.php?f=12&t=1103&p=1349#p1349]Community Translations[/url]

All creatives are invited to help us bring this game to all nations.

Apart of that we did lots of work on PC graphics, keyboard shortcuts and some minor texts fixies. We will announce the date for first update soon.
